rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ and mūla-kaulam

items.question: What additional attainments belong to the root Kaula teaching?
premises: These eight are linked with the attainment of powers.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula encompasses eight attainments that constitute the acquisition of powers.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the eight attainments is not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And there are eight: the attainment of powers, which is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
